title: Kill Cord: API Spend in Your Mac Menu Bar, Free
description: Kill Cord is a free Mac menu bar app that shows today's and this month's API spend across providers, and helps you turn on each provider's own spend caps.
og_title: Kill Cord: see your API spend before the bill does
og_description: Today's and this month's spend for Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, Vercel, Cloudflare, and more in your menu bar, plus a guided audit of each provider's own caps. Free for macOS.

title: Privacy: Where Kill Cord Keeps Your API Keys
description: Kill Cord keeps your provider keys in your Mac's Keychain, sends each only to its own provider, and has no telemetry, analytics, account or server of its own.
og_description: Keys stay in your Mac's Keychain and go only to the provider they belong to. No telemetry, no analytics, no account.
